headline: President Tinubu Receives Constitutional Amendment For State Police
seoTitle: Tinubu Receives State Police Constitutional Amendment Bill
metaDescription: President Bola Tinubu has received the constitutional amendment bill for state police following unanimous approval by all 36 state assemblies in Nigeria.
aiSummaryBullets: President Bola Tinubu has received the constitutional amendment bill seeking to establish state police in the country.
The legislative proposal reached the president after securing unanimous approval from all 36 state Houses of Assembly.
The president intends to consult the Attorney-General of the Federation regarding the legislation before deciding on his assent.
aiContextParagraph: The movement to establish state-level police forces in Nigeria reached a significant milestone as the relevant constitutional amendment bill was officially transmitted to President Bola Tinubu. This development follows confirmation from both the Senate and the House of Representatives that all 36 state assemblies across the federation have provided their required consent to the proposed changes. Proponents of the policy argue that localized policing could improve regional security, with some state leaders already indicating readiness to deploy personnel. As the bill enters the final stages of the legislative process, the President has indicated that he will hold formal consultations with the Attorney-General of the Federation to review the implications of the constitutional adjustment before taking further action. The transition of the bill to the presidency marks the culmination of an extensive deliberative process involving state and federal legislative bodies.
whyItIsViral: The development is receiving significant attention from two major national outlets and has generated strong search interest as the public tracks the transition of the security reform toward executive approval.
